rules.comment: CoMaps (Organic Maps fork): title = distance ('92 m'), text = road ('Kroonstraat'), and the turn DIRECTION is only an arrow icon, never text (real capture, 2026-07-30). Maneuver is UNKNOWN on purpose — the watch shows distance + road with a neutral marker, not a fabricated arrow. Locale-agnostic: only the numeric distance is matched. The leading number+unit title identifies a turn-by-turn notification; CoMaps' other notifications aren't titled with a bare distance.
